title: sync script: clean-path commit failure conflated with 'nothing to commit' — silent infinite retry loop
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 passes 1.2/3.6 (converged). sync-beads-workers.sh:274-279: any git commit failure (hook, disk) takes the same path as a legitimately-emptied merge: abort, no conflicted[] entry, exit 0. A branch whose only delta is .beads/oscore re-fails identically every run with no human signal. Fix: distinguish index-empty from commit-error; record the latter in conflicted[].
close_reason: Fixed in scripts/sync-beads-workers.sh. Both git-commit call sites (clean-merge path ~138, LLM-merge path ~163) previously conflated ANY commit failure with the legitimately-emptied-merge case (abort, no conflicted[] entry -> silent infinite retry). Fix inserts an 'elif git diff --cached --quiet' branch: empty index after normalization => quiet abort (unchanged); staged content present + commit failed (pre-commit hook, disk) => echo COMMIT FAILED and record branch in conflicted[] so a human sees it. Verified against a real git reproduction: a failing --no-edit commit leaves staged content + MERGE_HEAD, 'git diff --cached --quiet' returns 1, and 'git merge --abort' rewinds cleanly. bash -n passes. 3x codereview: the reviewer-model invocation (opencode run --agent plan -m kimi-k3) timed out/empty on 3 attempts, so the correctness/security/robustness passes were done by the implementer per step-4 fallback; all PASS, no findings.
